item.title: Solved: How to Extract Text from HTML Files using Python
item.description:
In the quest to extract text from an HTML file using Python, one might desire a solution that mimics the functionality of copying text from a web browser and pasting it into a text editor. While several methods exist, opting for a robust solution that handles poorly constructed HTML and interprets HTML entities correctly is essential. Here, I’ve compiled effective methods and practical examples for such tasks.

Top 7 Methods to Extract Text from HTML Files using Python
